description: This file is a Markdown documentation aimed at explaining how to extend and customize the OpenAPI schema in a FastAPI application. It provides descriptions, explanations, and code snippets for overriding the default OpenAPI schema generation, including the use of the `get_openapi` utility and custom modifications.

methods.name: custom_openapi
methods.description: A function to generate a custom OpenAPI schema, overriding the default schema with additional customizations like adding a `x-logo` extension.
